TeacherAgent.name: pose_question
TeacherAgent.description: The Teacher Agent generates a question with difficulty level and broadcasts it to ALL Student Agents.

output_updates.name: question_log
output_updates.description: Log of all posed questions with content and difficulty

output_updates.name: responses_buffer
output_updates.description: Buffer to collect all student responses

output_updates.name: expected_responses
output_updates.description: Number of expected responses from students

TeacherAgent.name: evaluate_responses
TeacherAgent.description: The Teacher Agent collects ALL student responses (raised and not raised), then selects ONE student based on teacher_criteria.

required_variables.name: will_raise_hand
required_variables.description: Whether the student raised their hand

required_variables.name: gesture_description
required_variables.description: Description of student's gesture or non-verbal state

required_variables.name: response_content
required_variables.description: The content of the response given by the Student Agent

required_variables.name: response_type
required_variables.description: Type of response provided (verbal or non-verbal)

required_variables.name: student_id
required_variables.description: The identifier of the Student Agent providing the response

required_variables.name: responses_buffer
required_variables.description: Buffer to collect all student responses before making selection

required_variables.name: expected_responses
required_variables.description: Number of expected responses to wait for

required_variables.name: teacher_criteria
required_variables.description: Criteria for selection (will be modified by external intervention)

output_updates.name: attention_distribution
output_updates.description: Record of which student received attention in each round

StudentAgent.name: respond_to_question
StudentAgent.description: The Student Agent decides whether to raise hand based on ability and willingness, then generates gesture description or non-verbal state.

required_variables.name: question_content
required_variables.description: Content of the question from QuestionPosedEvent

required_variables.name: difficulty
required_variables.description: Difficulty of the question from QuestionPosedEvent

required_variables.name: prompt_summary
required_variables.description: Student's background summary including academic level and communication skills
